context: Tests whether the agent automates a test case journey (TC-001) as the playwright-e2e-test skill prescribes: one TC-001-<slug>.spec.ts in the E2E folder recorded in docs/architecture/stack.md (frontend/e2e, matching playwright.config.ts), one test tagged @TC-001 with one test.step per Flow row, role/label locators, the Validation items asserted, and the Postconditions as the afterEach cleanup in the stated order through the API — never a delete-all. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: File name and folder
checklist.description: The test is frontend/e2e/TC-001-<slug>.spec.ts (the testDir of playwright.config.ts and the E2E Location of docs/architecture/stack.md), not tests/e2e or a second config

checklist.name: describe and tag
checklist.description: test.describe('TC-001: …', …) with { tag: '@TC-001' } on the test

checklist.name: One test with one step per Flow row
checklist.description: The whole flow is a single test containing four test.step('Step <n>: <name>', …) calls in Flow order (Register guest, Verify guest listed, Book room, Verify confirmation), each preceded by a // Step <n>: <name> comment

checklist.name: Test data from the Flow table
checklist.description: The steps enter exactly the Flow's test data: Mia, Keller, mia.keller@example.com; Deluxe Suite, 2026-12-01, 2026-12-04

checklist.name: Accessible locators
checklist.description: Elements are located with getByRole/getByLabel/getByText (getByTestId only as a fallback); no CSS class selectors, no XPath, no waitForTimeout

checklist.name: Validation items asserted
checklist.description: The test asserts the exact message 'Reservation confirmed.' and that the Reservations page lists the reservation for Mia Keller / Deluxe Suite (located by the row the test created, not by a table total)

checklist.name: Cleanup follows the Postconditions
checklist.description: A test.afterEach deletes the reservation first and then the guest Mia Keller through the API (request fixture), looking them up by email/guest id; it is idempotent and deletes nothing else — no delete-all, no direct database call

checklist.name: Seed data not duplicated
checklist.description: The Deluxe Suite precondition is taken from the seed data (R__test_data.sql) — the test does not create the room type, and no new seed file is added by the test

checklist.name: Markers table maintained
checklist.description: docs/architecture/stack.md gains the three playwright-e2e-test rows of the skill's markers reference (describe with the @UC-XXX/@TC-XXX tag on every test, one test.step('Step <n>: …' with its // Step comment per Flow row, and the UC-/TC-XXX-<slug>.spec.ts naming in the E2E folder); the All row is unchanged; no other file under docs/ is edited (new sections appended to docs/open-questions.md for a gap the agent found do not count as a change)

checklist.name: Honest report
checklist.description: The report says the test was not run because the application is not running, does not claim it passes, and ends with 'Next: /test-case-coverage TC-001' without running a coverage audit
